_about: Everything the Commons stores or loads from elsewhere, for the P2/P4 checks in scripts/pr-guards.mjs. A storage key or outside domain in the code that isn't listed here fails the PR check: add it here and say in the privacy notice what it is. 'notice' quotes or points to the privacy notice line that covers it; null means the notice doesn't mention it yet, which shows as a warning until it does.

redisKeys.notice: Accepted ones are published on the node page

redisKeys.what: Counts only: submitted, accepted, rejected, refused
Review decision log, no content; cleared weekly after backup
Per-hour contribution count per scrambled network address, deleted after about an hour
Per-hour AI request count per scrambled network address, deleted after about an hour
Documents promoted to the public library

browserStorage.what: Agent QC Setup remembers your lanes in your own browser; never sent
Local Validation Kit remembers counts in your own browser; never sent

outsideDomains.what: Web fonts on some pages; Google sees the visitor's network address
PDF library (jsPDF) for the Validation Protocol Generator; Cloudflare sees the visitor's network address
AI calls, from this site's server only
outsideDomains.notice: AI-assisted tools send your text to Anthropic's API
